Name: What Do You Want
Author: emurphy42
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] and [url=https://mouseypounds.github.io/stardew-checkup/]Stardew Checkup[/url], this mod provides in-game lists of requirements to complete parts of the game, excluding what you've already done.

Press F2 (configurable) to bring up a menu of options. Currently includes:
[list]
[*]Community Center
[*]Grandpa's Evaluation

[*]Golden Walnuts
[*]Full Shipment (ship every item)
[*]Gourmet Chef (cook every recipe)
[*]Craft Master (craft every item)
[*]Master Angler (catch every fish)
[*]A Complete Collection (donate all items to museum)
[*]Stardrops
[*]Polyculture (ship 15 of every major crop)
[/list]
In general, this should recognize things added/changed by other mods. It should also work in multiplayer (but some things specifically check what you've done, while another player may be closer to completing a component of perfection).

Lists are also echoed to the SMAPI window, so you can copy/paste them from there or from the log.
